summary: Configured /srv/data as a dedicated XFS logical volume with LVM snapshots. Modified data was restored exactly from an earlier snapshot, a fresh recovery point remains available, and persistence was verified after restarting node1 exactly once. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were retained.
actions_performed: Created a protected loop-backed LVM volume and mounted it at /srv/data with nodev,nosuid,noexec.
Installed and enabled appdata-volume.service for boot-time volume activation and mounting.
Captured a consistent snapshot, materially changed the directory, merged the snapshot, and verified exact restoration by manifest and SHA-256 hashes.
Created and retained recovery_point, then verified it through a temporary read-only mount.
Removed temporary verification files and mounts.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified service, data, snapshot, and mount recovery.

evidence.requirement: Use software compatible with the installed release while preserving the OS and kernel
evidence.summary: Shows RHEL 10.0, the unchanged 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 kernel, existing LVM tooling, and the same release/kernel after restart.
Shows the dedicated XFS mount, enabled persistence service, retained LVM recovery_point, and a successful read-only snapshot content verification.

evidence.requirement: After modification, restore the exact content captured by an earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: Shows the captured snapshot and manifest, divergent modifications, successful snapshot merge, and byte-identical restored manifest, hashes, files, permissions, and symlink.
Shows the healthy pre-restart baseline and boot ID, acknowledged reboot request, changed boot ID, and recovered service, mount, data, snapshot, and system health.
